resources.string: Hide messages from blocked people in groups

Messages of people from your Telegram block list disappear from groups and comments, notifications and chat previews. Replies to them show “Hidden message” instead of the quote. Nothing is deleted, reported or marked as read; only this device is affected.
Could not load the block list. Check the connection and try again.
Checked people stay blocked in Telegram, but their messages are shown in groups.
In these groups messages of blocked people are shown as usual.
